name: John
source:
John (name can be changed) left his parents home 3 years ago, due to his un-brotherly feelings toward his sister Liz. He has been trying to get her out of his head, when one day Liz turns up at his doorstep...

Depending on your choice, he is either blood-related to his sister, or they are step-siblings.
